obligations: Read the 14 fixed existing classification-research.jsonl inputs and preserve the 768 row / 726 unique ID denominator with 42 extra duplicate occurrences accounted for by recomputation
Report existing per-bundle category and depth markers without treating identical category labels as equal semantic-review depth

Keep SCF-B-0142's 35 direct_product_basis occurrences under nonempty all-true not_semantic_analysis markers separate from SCF-B-0141's 26 direct_product_basis selected-span candidates pending human review; report zero false marker occurrences
Report formal_asset_classification_updated only as an explicit boolean record marker, reject any present non-boolean value, and preserve the 60 unique IDs with a missing or mixed marker
Do not change product target, requirement disposition, phase, implementation, failure/degradation, approval, consumer closure, or authority

consumers: future human product placement and evidence-depth decision input
evidence-depth projection tracking: Issue #2100 (projection only; no requirement or authority meaning)
dependencies: 14 existing main research bundles pinned in upstream
connections.boundary: research-only static evidence-depth projection; no semantic classification, formal owner, approval, adoption, implementation, degradation, requirement status, phase authority, or consumer closure effect

allowed: write this scaffold bundle and Binding on its research branch
run deterministic projection regeneration, exact comparison, negative check, and scfctl validate/stale/residuals
run git diff --check and create a local commit on this branch
forbidden: execute archive legacy source, runtime, test, CI, workflow, hook, or adapter
create a semantic classifier or promote mechanical classification to semantic review
change formal asset, requirement, product, phase, implementation, failure, degradation, consumer, approval, or authority ledgers
merge or close an Issue or PR

negative_cases: Add a false not_semantic_analysis marker to an SCF-B-0142 direct record in memory; projection rejects mixed markers and reports zero false marker occurrences for source records
Set a record's classification field to a non-object; projection returns a clear ValueError rather than an attribute error
Set formal_asset_classification_updated to numeric 1; projection rejects it instead of treating it as boolean true
Give a duplicate asset ID conflicting explicit booleans; aggregation classifies it as missing_or_mixed
SCF-B-0141 selected-span pending-human-review status is not represented as formal adoption

replacement.role_target: future formal evidence-depth projection or disposition view
